Maria: opened PR #4243 for the migration guide — needs 2 reviewers and a docs preview before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4243
Sam: I can review content later today. CI/docs preview is failing right now though.
Docs-Bot: docs preview build started for PR #4243
Docs-Bot: docs preview build: FAIL — broken link at /sdk/python/quickstart
Jake: I can do the narrative/compatibility review and check the example outputs. @Sam can you pick up CLI/snippet checks?
Priya: heads up I'm OOO tomorrow, so can't take reviewer duty.
Ben: I can run the snippets and validate outputs if someone can point to the failing link.
Maria: Not urgent but prefer to merge by EOW. Main asks: verify code examples run, and confirm the 'batching-config' snippet matches runtime defaults.
Ben: copying the broken link from bot: /sdk/python/quickstart -> looks like file moved in v2. I'll run examples locally after Sam updates the link.
Sam: will update redirects and push a tiny patch in a few mins, then trigger preview rebuild.
Akshay: quick note — docs reviewer rotation shows @Jake oncall this week. Maybe use oncall first before broad pings.
Jake: I'm oncall; I can do content checks. Ben please run any integration snippets and paste outputs here.
Ben: running now. snippet: `python examples/quickstart.py` -> OK, tokenization example printed expected output. Will attach logs in PR.
Maria: @Sam once your fix lands can you re-run preview and post the new URL here? I'll re-request reviews after success.
Sam: pushed fix and updated redirect rule.
Docs-Bot: docs preview build started for PR #4243
Docs-Bot: docs preview build: SUCCESS — https://deploy-preview-4243--redwood-docs.netlify.app
Maria: great — added @Jake and @Ben as reviewers on the PR and included a short checklist for reviewer responsibilities.
Jake: reviewed and left minor wording suggestions around quantized model caveat.
Ben: snippets passed. approved.
Maria: requesting one approval + green CI for merge. I'll wait until tomorrow morning then merge if no more issues.
Jake: approved ✅
Maria: merged PR #4243 — thanks everyone :tada:
Priya: nice, thanks team!
